title: Diego López de Ayala (Brussels) to Cardinal Cisneros, 30 August 1516 (AGS Estado leg. 496 fol. 22, DECODE R9954)

documents.route: Diego López de Ayala (Brussels) to Cardinal Cisneros

plaintext.source: no decipherment on the record; read with Tomokiyo's key rebuilt from R10024

transcription.source: read directly from DECODE images AGS 0002-0006 into plain_0002_0003.txt and plain_0004_0006.txt
transcription.notes: Deciphered line by line from the images without a separate sign transcription, so no token count; lower half of AGS 0003 faded with show-through.

system.summary: Simple substitution of invented signs for Spanish letters, with a few name and word signs (Xebres, que).
system.notes: Key as rebuilt by Tomokiyo from R10024 (KEY.md); a few variant signs (a = 9 or 6, o with or without stroke, I-shaped s) and four unresolved signs.

prior_solution.where: Key published by Tomokiyo (cryptiana spanish2C) from R10024; he notes an endorsement suggesting a nineteenth-century decipherment but prints no reading, and none was found in print (Documentos inéditos 1516-1517 prints only a clear letter of the same day).

conditions.human_role: Project-level: obtained a DECODE login and passed its session cookie to the model, and posed the problem with /goal. No target-specific intervention recorded.

solution.what: DECODE record R9954 and its 8 images fetched; page order mapped to AGS 0001-0008.
Tomokiyo spanish2C: same cipher as R10024, key rebuilt there; no reading printed.
Tomokiyo's key figure transcribed to KEY.md and applied to AGS 0002 line 1: 'cerca delos oficios que estan vacos en estos reynos'.
AGS 0002-0006 deciphered line by line; 0002 and 0005 in full, 0003 and 0006 to mid-page, 0004 partly letter by letter.
Real Academia de Toledo Documentos inéditos (1516-1517) searched: no. 36 is a different, clear Ayala letter of the same day; Gayangos 1867 prints Cisneros's side only.

Second image pass at 2x with autocontrast by two agents: AGS 0003 lines 18-26 read; weak lines on 0002, 0004, 0006 re-read; key corrections Phi=m, hook=j, I-sign and looped sign = s, X. = q inside words, H. = Xebres confirmed in context.

outcome.notes: About nine tenths read in sense after a second pass: offices and Chièvres, the Orders, Queen Germaine, the peace of Noyon, Charles's departure, Chièvres and the Chancellor. Single words open on each page.
